description: This file defines an interface and a class for creating and managing MySQL database connections with configuration options, including URL parsing and connection string building.

classes.name: IMySqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Interface declaring a method for creating database connections.

classes.name: MySqlConnectionFactory
classes.description: Concrete implementation creating MySQL connections based on environment configuration.

methods.name: CreateConnection
methods.description: Creates and returns a new MySQL database connection using configured options.

methods.name: TryParsePort
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string port into an integer, returning null if unsuccessful.

methods.name: ParseMysqlUrl
methods.description: Parses a MySQL URL string to extract host, port, and database name.
